technical_and_design_decisions: Develop a benchmarking harness for Sqoop vs. jdbchdfs batch jobs utilizing realistic synthetic datasets on a test Hadoop environment.
Expose configurable codec properties (e.g., none, snappy, deflate) in the Avro hdfs-dataset sink module options.
Expose custom JavaMail properties via configuration options in the Mail sink module to support SSL/TLS socket factories.
Update batch job schema/metadata metadata models to expose partitionResultsTimeout attribute and propagate it across the 3 OOTB single-step partitioning job definitions.
Upgrade project build files to Spring Boot 1.2.0.RELEASE and update all specified third-party dependencies, resolving API incompatibilities across Spring Framework 4.1.3 and Spring Batch 3.0.2.
Implement external YAML deployment manifest reader in the stream parser/CLI component.
Implement GZIP/ZIP compression and decompression transformers in Spring Integration pipelines.
Integrate payload compression/decompression into RabbitMQ source and sink modules using Spring AMQP header and converter support.
assumptions: Development and testing environments (Hadoop, RabbitMQ, Mail server) are readily accessible.
The developer will execute all activities end-to-end including design, code implementation, testing, and documentation updates.
All software updates will be verified using automated unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_description: Analyze technical requirements across user stories, establish dependency upgrade strategy for Spring Boot 1.2.0, and design external YAML deployment manifest parsing.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Sqoop vs. jdbchdfs Performance Benchmarking
activities.activity_description: Build benchmarking test harness, set up test datasets, execute Sqoop vs jdbchdfs batch executions, and collect and document performance metrics.

activities.activity_name: U2 - HDFS-Dataset Sink Avro Compression Config
activities.activity_description: Add codec configuration support (including disabling snappy and selecting custom codecs) for Avro files in hdfs-dataset sink, and write unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Mail Sink TLS/SSL Properties Support
activities.activity_description: Enhance Mail sink module to accept javaMailProperties bean definitions (SSL/TLS properties, custom socket factory) and write test cases with secured mail connection.
Expose partitionResultsTimeout in batch job metadata wiki/schema and apply updates across the 3 OOTB jobs inheriting single-step partitioning.
Upgrade project build definitions to Spring Boot 1.2.0.RELEASE and all specified dependencies, refactor code affected by breaking library changes, and fix build failures.

activities.activity_name: U6 - External YML File Support for Deployment Manifest
activities.activity_description: Implement feature allowing deployment manifest properties to be loaded from a separate YML file rather than inline stream definitions, and add unit tests.
Implement gzip and zip compression/decompression transformers for message payloads and integrate with general message processing flow.

activities.activity_name: U8 - RabbitMQ Source & Sink Compression Support
activities.activity_description: Extend RabbitMQ source and sink modules to support message compression/decompression configuration options and test with RabbitMQ broker.
Execute full regression test suite, perform end-to-end integration testing, and update system documentation and release notes.
